title: dactylorhiza maculata var. heinzeliana
intro: Dactylorhiza maculata var. heinzeliana, commonly known as spotted marsh orchid, is a variety of orchid that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help with inflammation, respiratory issues, and as an antiseptic agent. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza maculata var. heinzeliana include its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
